👋 About The Little Book Nook

Welcome to The Little Book Nook, a neighbourhood children’s library created by Meher and Malhaar.

We are Meher (12) and Malhaar (7) — two sisters who absolutely love reading. Our shelves are full of adventures, fairy magic, animal stories, mysteries, and everything in between.

One day we looked at all the books we had finished and thought: “Wouldn’t it be lovely if other children could enjoy these stories too?”

That’s how The Little Book Nook was born. It’s our personal collection that we share with friends, neighbours, and anyone who wants to discover a good book.

💛 We started this tiny library simply to spread the joy of reading — one book at a time.

Whether you like Rainbow Magic fairies, Horrid Henry’s mischief, animal rescues, or big adventures, we hope you’ll find something here that makes you smile and keeps you turning pages.

Happy reading!
— Meher & Malhaar

📖 How to Borrow a Book

We’d love to share our books with you! Here’s how it works:

1. Choose your book

Browse the catalog and find a story you’d like to read. Note the title and author.

2. Send us a WhatsApp

Message us on WhatsApp with the book title and author name.

💬 WhatsApp 99309 99894

We’ll reply to confirm if the book is available.

3. Come and collect

Once we confirm that the book is available, we will share the collection details on WhatsApp.

ATS Pristine
Sector 150, Noida
📍 Open in Google Maps →

Simple rules

  • You may borrow 1 book at a time.
  • Please return the book within 10 days.
  • When you take a book, we’ll need a contact number and address.
  • We ask for a small contribution of ₹10 per book to help us maintain and grow the library.

Please take good care of the books so that many more children can enjoy them after you. Thank you! 🌟

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Can I borrow more than one book?
At the moment we allow only 1 book at a time. This way more children get a chance to read. Once you return your book, you’re welcome to borrow another!
What if I need a few extra days?
Just send us a WhatsApp message before the 10 days are up. We’re usually happy to give a short extension if the book isn’t needed by someone else.
Do I need to message before coming?
Yes, please. Message us first so we can confirm the book is available and we’re home. It saves you an unnecessary trip!
Is the ₹10 fee compulsory?
Yes. It’s a small contribution that helps us keep the books in good condition and occasionally add new ones to the Nook.
What age are the books for?
Most books are suitable for children roughly 5–12 years. You can filter by age recommendation in the catalog to find the best match.
Can adults borrow too?
Most books are suitable for children aged 5–12 years. Parents are welcome to explore and borrow books together with their children.
What if a book gets damaged?
Please take good care of the books. If something happens, just let us know honestly — accidents can occur. We’ll figure out a fair way forward together.
How do I return a book?
Message us on WhatsApp when you’re ready to return, then drop it back at the same address. We’ll confirm we’ve received it.
